profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Pratt & Whitney
profile.summary:
Experienced Systems Analyst & Administrator with broad expertise in design, development and 
maintenance of complex software and management of server infrastructures and data center operations 
across operating system platforms. Highly proficient in implementing enterprise solutions for business 
applications in broad scale, web-delivered environments. Determined to deliver best technical solutions to 
meet functional and business requirements. Diligent troubleshooter, with effective communication skills to 
interact effectively with employees and departments various IT environments. Flexible with positive work 
attitude focused on producing results under tight deadlines. Demonstrated understanding of the Software 
Development Life Cycle. Support physical and virtual hosting including private and public cloud hosting 
options, operating systems, databases, middleware, storage, and backup. Bilingual: English and Spanish.

positions.insights: Python, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +1 skill

positions.title: Business System Analyst
positions.description: As a Business System Analyst, I excel at translating complex business needs into effective technological solutions that drive operational efficiency and strategic growth. With expertise in requirements gathering, process improvement, and data analysis, I have a proven track record of identifying opportunities for enhancement and implementing data-driven solutions that align with organizational goals. My experience includes overseeing system implementations and integrations, managing cross-functional projects, and facilitating clear communication between technical teams and stakeholders. Notable achievements include leading a legacy system revamp that increased processing efficiency, developing a comprehensive reporting system that improved data accuracy, and managing a seamless CRM transition that boosted customer satisfaction. I am committed to using my analytical skills and innovative mindset to tackle complex challenges and deliver impactful results for forward-thinking organizations.
positions.insights: IT Business Analysis, Systems Planning and +2 skills

company.name: Puerto Rico Innovation and Technology Service

positions.title: Senior Associate Information Systems Database Administrator
positions.description: In my role as a Senior Associate DBA, I played a essential role in supporting Infrastructure Operations, focusing on Oracle Database and MS-SQL Server Administration, all while ensuring strict compliance with company and government regulations in audit and security. Operating in a 24x7 regulated environment, I coordinate database administration functions for both development and production settings. Additionally, I embrace the opportunity to expand my expertise into new database technologies introduced into the Amgen environment. My responsibilities encompass a wide range of tasks, including collaborating with the Service Owner, peers, and service providers to enhance technology services. I ensure that services align with key principles of service ownership, emphasizing business needs, cost-effectiveness, scalability, compliance, reliability, and resilience. My database administration duties encompass installations, upgrades, access control, backup/recovery, vendor contract management, disaster recovery, development/test environment support, documentation, and infrastructure enhancements. I actively contribute to application and database design decisions, striving for high levels of performance, security, scalability, maintainability, and reliability. I excel in investigating and proposing solutions for technical database challenges, supporting leadership in managing a portfolio of databases, and collaborating on planning, implementing, and configuring Oracle and MS-SQL Database software in adherence to security regulations, policies, and best practices. My commitment lies in optimizing technology services and staying at the forefront of emerging database technologies.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Oracle Database Administration and +4 skills

positions.title: Oracle & MS-SQL Server Data Base Administrator
positions.description: In my previous role, I led and supervised various critical tasks within the realm of database administration. I oversaw the installation, configuration, upgrades, and patching of database and reporting systems, ensuring alignment with Database management directives. Additionally, I implemented and managed a robust backup strategy to safeguard application and system databases. My responsibilities also encompassed troubleshooting a wide array of issues, adhering to predefined service level agreements, and collaborating with Database Developers to resolve complex problems while focusing on performance and reliability enhancements. I actively maintained and optimized databases through indexing, configuration adjustments, and statistical analysis to prevent issues. My dedication to database security was evident through the rigorous implementation of access control, encryption, and auditing measures. I played a pivotal role in orchestrating quality assurance, user acceptance testing, and database deployments for new applications and bug fixes. Furthermore, I spearheaded disaster recovery and high availability solutions under the direction of management and ensured meticulous documentation for installations, configurations, and applications. My commitment to enhancing reliability and performance in online processing databases was unwavering. As a leader, I managed projects and ongoing activities related to database operations and organization, constantly evaluating and implementing new technologies. I consistently identified opportunities for database improvements and conveyed these insights to management. Throughout my tenure, I maintained strict compliance with all rules, regulations, policies, and procedures established by management, while also fulfilling additional duties as assigned.

positions.title: Consultant Oracle & MS-SQL Server Database Administrator
positions.locationName: AVE ARTERIAL HOSTOS, HATO REY, PUERTO RICO · On-site
positions.description: As an Oracle and SQL Server Database Administrator at Santander Bank Computer Center, I played a pivotal role in ensuring the robustness of the bank's IT infrastructure. I successfully coordinated and executed database rolls, including rigorous testing and certification processes, guaranteeing the reliability of critical systems. My daily routine involved meticulous maintenance of the database infrastructure, where I diligently monitored nightly logs and addressed any issues promptly. I was also responsible for monitoring replication activities, responding to related problems, and contributing significantly to Disaster Recovery efforts. Coordinating hardware maintenance and upgrades was a key aspect of my role, as was implementing software maintenance and upgrades for database servers. I excelled in troubleshooting database server and connectivity issues, quickly resolving database challenges escalated by the business teams. My commitment to security was unwavering, as I maintained and implemented server, database, and user security measures, including access rights and permissions. Additionally, I effectively managed assigned databases, continuously monitoring disk utilization and performing version restores as necessary. My role extended to collaborating with Developers to coordinate the development and implementation of new database applications and replicating environments as required. I was always ready to take on additional duties to ensure the seamless operation of critical systems.
